functions.title: Search expenses
functions.description: Search MinzSpend expense records visible to the verified user. The default mine scope includes self and currently authorized proxy records; all is restricted to users with Spend team-view, control, or admin access.

completeness.notes: Count is exact within the authorized scope and filters; rows are bounded to twenty and offset pagination is capped at 10,000.

functions.declaration: declare function search(args?: { scope?: 'mine' | 'all'; query?: string; status?: 'draft' | 'submitted' | 'approved' | 'rejected' | 'reimbursed'; category?: string; from?: string; to?: string; limit?: number; offset?: number }): Promise<ExpenseSearchResult>; // from/to must be paired

functions.title: Search expense reports
functions.description: Search MinzSpend expense settlement and reimbursement reports. These are expense reports, not P&L, general-ledger, or other accounting statements. The default mine scope includes self and currently authorized proxy records; all is restricted to users with Spend team-view, control, or admin access.

completeness.notes: Count is exact within the authorized scope and filters; rows are bounded to twenty and offset pagination is capped at 10,000. Reports may contain multiple currencies; monetary totals are omitted.
